messages:
anya (docs): Quick heads-up: the API ref for /v1/rerank currently shows `score` as a normalized 0.0-1.0 value in the response examples, but the service actually returns raw logits (can be negative or >1). Caught this while updating the SDK examples.

ben (sdk): Oof. Which file? I was just updating the JS helper to expect 0-1 and added an assertion.

anya (docs): docs/reference/rerank.md — example JSON: `{ items: [{id: 'a', score: 0.87}] }`. Runtime returns `{ items: [{id: 'a', score: 5.12}] }` for that model.

omar (api): Confirmed. Historically we had a normalized score in an earlier iteration, then moved to raw logits for better internal ranking fidelity. We didn't update some examples. Behavior is intentional.

dina (pm): Does this break any customers? Should we treat as a docs-only fix or add a compatibility layer?

omar (api): Most client SDKs already map or rescale scores in higher-level helpers. Only customers parsing raw responses and assuming 0-1 might be surprised. I prefer docs + migration guidance rather than changing runtime.

anya (docs): Plan: update examples to show raw-logit values and add a small "Interpreting scores" note explaining raw logits vs normalized probabilities and offering a snippet for normalizing (simple softmax or min-max depending on use). Also add an SDK note linking to util normalizeScore().

ben (sdk): I'll remove the assertion and add normalizeScore() to the JS helper with a short example in docs. I'll open a joint PR.

ci-bot: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/834 by ben (sdk)  runs: docs lint, examples test.

anya (docs): Checklist before merge: 1) update rerank.md examples 2) add "Interpreting scores" section 3) link SDK normalize helper 4) run linkcheck and samples lint.

dina (pm): Add a short release-note blurb: "Docs: clarified rerank scores are raw logits; added normalization examples and SDK helper." Make sure to mention models that still emit normalized scores if any.

omar (api): Note added to PR: models flagged `normalized_scores:true` in catalog will appear 0-1 — docs will call that out.

ci-bot: All checks passed for PR #834.

ben (sdk): Merged. @anya please add release-note blurb; I'll update SDK minor version.

anya (docs): Draft blurb: "Docs: clarified rerank endpoint score semantics — responses use raw logits by default; see normalization examples and SDK helper for mapping to 0-1 probabilities."

dina (pm): LGTM, thanks team!

anya (docs): Closing thread — thanks for the quick turnaround.
